response.sql: WITH telescope_counts AS (SELECT observstation, COUNT(*) AS telescope_count FROM telescopes GROUP BY observstation), shares AS (SELECT telescope_count, 1.0 * telescope_count / SUM(telescope_count) OVER () AS share FROM telescope_counts), average_share AS (SELECT AVG(share) AS value FROM shares) SELECT COALESCE(SUM(telescope_count), 0) AS total_telescopes, AVG(share) AS average_share, AVG(share - average_share.value) AS average_excess_share FROM shares CROSS JOIN average_share WHERE share > average_share.value;
